explanation: The Ollantaytambo article gives the raid its reason in so many words: "As a result of these events, neither side was able to break the deadlock at Cusco for several months, so the Spaniard garrison decided to make a direct attack on Manco's headquarters at the town of Ollantaytambo, 70 km northwest of the city." The lead says the same: "To end the stand-off, the besieged mounted a raid against the emperor's headquarters." `caused`: the deadlock at Cusco is what the article says produced the expedition, not merely what preceded it. Probable, and with a second author: the sentence carries Hemming, The Conquest of the Incas, p. 206.
